title: FNR3 PSP debug-build AIP native dispatch cross-map

debug_reference.note: Reference binary is not tracked; only derived non-expressive metadata is committed.

findings: Debug and retail BOOT.BIN have identical .text, .data, and .bss sizes.
The debug build uses the same key AIP/UI function address family already present in the retail static map, allowing direct address-level cross-reference for the bounded functions below.
The debug ELF retains additional relocation/development metadata but no conventional .symtab/.strtab or DWARF .debug_* sections.

registration.func_000CF9C4: insert/register node in FSCommand handler BST
registration.func_000CFE08: insert/register node in LoadVariables handler BST

dispatch.func_000D024C: FSCommand dispatch: parse name, search FS handler BST, indirect-call matched handler; returns handled/not-handled result
dispatch.func_000D041C: LoadVariables dispatch: parse name, search LV handler BST, indirect-call matched handler, return produced result
dispatch.func_000D066C: diagnostic dump of FSHandler and LVHandler lists

diagnostic_strings: << AIP >> WARNING! No FS handler found for "%s"
<< AIP >> WARNING! No LV handler found for "%s"

debug_menu_binding.implication: The debug-menu APT can retrieve menu data through DEBUG_GetDebugMenuData and invoke action callbacks through DEBUG_OnAdvance / DEBUG_OnRealFE. The exact APT bytecode call sites remain to be decoded.

handler_descriptors.note: The static initializer stores descriptor addresses into the globals consumed by the registration glue; each descriptor's +0x0C function pointer identifies the concrete handler implementation.

behavior: Enumerates boxer candidates for the first two selectors and builds paired display-string / numeric-ID arrays.
Enumerates venue candidates for the third selector using Venue_%d-style keys.
Reads the three selected IDs from the AIP request.
Obtains the fight-session singleton through func_001B3EA8.
Applies the first two values through the two-corner boxer-selection path.
Applies the third value through a separate fight-session selection path consistent with the venue selector.
Runs the subsequent fight/front-end transition sequence.

on_real_fe.behavior: Routes back to the normal front end/main menu.

provenance: Static disassembly of the user-provided ULES00270 debug/review BOOT.BIN.
Cross-checked against the existing ULUS10066-v1.00 retail address/evidence map in this repository.
No copyrighted executable bytes are stored in this artifact.

fixed_count_evidence: six explicitly-named AIP arrays are populated
get_select_boxer_info.stock_selectable_ids: 0..34 inclusive across six divisions (35 entries in the initial range table)
get_select_boxer_info.roster_cap_note: The handler contains no 121-entry roster cap. It builds six lists from per-division start/end globals. This does not by itself prove that the database/save architecture can exceed 121 records.
get_select_boxer_info.random_selection_corroboration: SetSelectBoxerInfo at 0x001D87E0 uses the same enum order and chooses random IDs as start + (rng % count), directly confirming the start/count table semantics.

update_select_boxer_info.behavior: When a concrete boxer ID is supplied, builds/resolves that boxer and publishes the nine SelectBoxer rating properties. When iBoxerID == -1 it follows the current-corner/current-boxer path instead.

rating_outputs.iSpeed: rating accessor slot 2 -> schema field ID 0x12
rating_outputs.iAgility: rating accessor slot 3 -> schema field ID 0x13
rating_outputs.iStamina: rating accessor slot 4 -> schema field ID 0x14
